menu:10049340:1.text: Human! Seeing you... makes me happy!

say:0:1534101001:0.text: Once the light source was removed, Sedecim reverted to a lifeless state—completely still, completely silent.
say:0:1534101001:0.source_cn: 光源被取出后，十六彻底变回了无法行动和言语的木偶。

say:1:1534101002:0.text: Just a dusty, broken puppet now, missing pieces and sitting all alone. The sight stirs a sharp pang of sadness in your chest.
say:1:1534101002:0.source_cn: 沉默的、灰扑扑的木偶，甚至还缺了点零件。看着它孤零零坐...
say:1:1534101002:0.male: Just a dusty, broken puppet now, missing pieces and sitting all alone. The sight stirs a sharp pang of sadness in your chest.
say:1:1534101002:0.female: Just a dusty, broken puppet now, missing pieces and sitting all alone. The sight stirs a sharp pang of sadness in your chest.

say:2:1534101003:1.text: If only there were a way to repair Sedecim... but Tully's blueprints are incomplete.
say:2:1534101003:1.source_cn: 要是有什么办法能修好十六就好了，可惜塔利留下的设计稿不全……

say:3:1534101004:0.text: Perhaps <style="highlight">the ruins near the Wailing Oak</style> hold what you need. You might find the missing sections of Sedecim's design there.
say:3:1534101004:0.source_cn: 或许你可以去<style=highlight>人面树附...
say:3:1534101004:0.male: Perhaps <style="highlight">the ruins near the Wailing Oak</style> hold what you need. You might find the missing sections of Sedecim's design there.
say:3:1534101004:0.female: Perhaps <style="highlight">the ruins near the Wailing Oak</style> hold what you need. You might find the missing sections of Sedecim's design there.

narration:0:1534102001:0.text: You pull out Tully's journal and piece together the fragments you've found...
narration:0:1534102001:0.source_cn: 你拿出了塔利的日记，将找到的残片拼了上去……

say:0:1534103001:0.text: For an energy core, you could draw a little light from the <style="highlight">Harvest Altar</style>.
say:0:1534103001:0.source_cn: 能量源可以去<style=highlight>丰饶祭坛...
say:0:1534103001:0.male: For an energy core, you could draw a little light from the <style="highlight">Harvest Altar</style>.
say:0:1534103001:0.female: For an energy core, you could draw a little light from the <style="highlight">Harvest Altar</style>.

say:1:1534103002:0.text: As for spare parts and tools... <style="highlight">search the surrounding area</style>.
say:1:1534103002:0.source_cn: 至于零件和维修工具……在这<style=highlig...
say:1:1534103002:0.male: As for spare parts and tools... <style="highlight">search the surrounding area</style>.
say:1:1534103002:0.female: As for spare parts and tools... <style="highlight">search the surrounding area</style>.

say:3:1534104003:1.text: Sedecim's heart... helped Master... and everyone?
say:3:1534104003:1.source_cn: 十六的心……帮助到主人，和大家？
say:3:1534104003:1.male: Sedecim's heart... helped Master... and everyone?
say:3:1534104003:1.female: Sedecim's heart... helped Master... and everyone?

say:9:1534104007:1.text: At the altar. At Master's home. At Master's tree... continue patrol.
say:9:1534104007:1.source_cn: 在祭坛，在主人家，在主人的树，继续巡逻。
say:9:1534104007:1.male: At the altar. At Master's home. At Master's tree... continue patrol.
say:9:1534104007:1.female: At the altar. At Master's home. At Master's tree... continue patrol.

say:10:1534104008:1.text: I... will stay here, to protect everyone.
say:10:1534104008:1.source_cn: 十六……继续留在这里，保护大家。
say:10:1534104008:1.male: I... will stay here, to protect everyone.
say:10:1534104008:1.female: I... will stay here, to protect everyone.

say:11:1534104009:1.text: When you come again, I can... light your way!
say:11:1534104009:1.source_cn: 人……再来的时候，十六可以……帮你照亮！
say:11:1534104009:1.male: When you come again, I can... light your way!
say:11:1534104009:1.female: When you come again, I can... light your way!

say:12:1534104010:1.text: As long as I remain, it won't be all dark again. I... can be a light source!
say:12:1534104010:1.source_cn: 十六在这里，这里就……不是只有黑。十六……可以成为光源！
say:12:1534104010:1.male: As long as I remain, it won't be all dark again. I... can be a light source!
say:12:1534104010:1.female: As long as I remain, it won't be all dark again. I... can be a light source!

say:1:1534105001:1.text: You! Seeing you... makes me happy.
say:1:1534105001:1.male: You! Seeing you... makes me happy.
say:1:1534105001:1.female: You! Seeing you... makes me happy.

say:2:1534105002:1.text: It's dark here, but I can bring light. With light... there is no fear.
say:2:1534105002:1.source_cn: 这里很黑，十六可以照亮。有光，就不怕。
say:2:1534105002:1.male: It's dark here, but I can bring light. With light... there is no fear.
say:2:1534105002:1.female: It's dark here, but I can bring light. With light... there is no fear.
